title: Credential inside single or double quotes: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix namespace: NRAX- vs the provider-documented NRAK- user-key prefix, prefix namespace: glsx_ vs the provider-documented glsa service-account prefix, and prefix namespace: glx_ vs the provider-documented glc_ access-policy token prefix. Twin of "Credential inside single or double quotes: must be flagged (provider-documented)".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of grafana-cloud-access-policy-token-single-quotes: prefix namespace: glx_ vs the provider-documented glc_ access-policy token prefix. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
